title: Sobha Sector 63A
location: Sector 63A, Golf Course Extension Road, Gurgaon
address: Sobha Sector 63A, Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram, Haryana
details: Sobha Sector 63A is a premium luxury residential development located on Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram, crafted by SOBHA Limited for refined urban living. The project offers spacious 3 & 4 BHK residences with elegant layouts, premium interiors, expansive balconies, and thoughtfully planned living spaces designed for comfort and sophistication. Surrounded by landscaped greens and world-class lifestyle amenities, the development combines modern architecture with seamless connectivity to major business hubs, top educational institutions, healthcare centers, retail destinations, and entertainment zones across Gurgaon. With premium recreational spaces, luxury clubhouse experiences, wellness amenities, and excellent infrastructure growth in the surrounding region, Sobha Sector 63A delivers a balanced lifestyle experience along with strong long-term investment potential in one of Gurgaon’s most prestigious residential corridors.
